### PgGucEnumOption(string, int, bool)

Describes one label of an enumerated configuration parameter defined at run time.

```csharp
public PgGucEnumOption(string Name, int Value, bool Hidden = false)
```

Parameters:

`Name` — [string](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.string)

The label PostgreSQL accepts, compared with its case-insensitive ASCII rules.

`Value` — [int](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.int32)

The ordinal stored for the label; aliases share an ordinal, and the first label is displayed.

`Hidden` — [bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

Whether the label is accepted but omitted from lists of available values.
